findings.comment: Owner is identified as WM 41 Austin RE, LLC (a legal entity). Application is signed by Richard D. Agnew listed as Authorized Signer. No corporate resolution, operating agreement extract, or other documentation demonstrating signatory's legal authority to bind the entity is included in the submittal package.

Applicant (Jason Rodgers, P.E., Bleyl Engineering) is not the property owner (WM 41 Austin RE, LLC). A separate owner's authorization letter or authorization form from the record owner authorizing the applicant to submit on behalf of the owner is not clearly evident in the submittal package.

Owner is a legal entity (WM 41 Austin RE, LLC) with signatory identified as Authorized Signer (Richard D. Agnew), but documentation proving the signatory's authority to bind the entity (corporate resolution, operating agreement extract, partnership resolution, trust document, or similar) is not provided in the submittal.

Warranty deed is not submitted as a supporting document in the application package, although the application references deed Document Number 2019197883. The recorded warranty deed establishing current ownership of the subject property must be provided.

Affidavit of No Liens is not found in the supplementary documents submitted with the application. A formally notarized affidavit signed by the record owner (WM 41 Austin RE, LLC) or the record owner's authorized agent, including notary signature, official seal, and acknowledgment date, is required.
Affidavit of No Liens is not submitted. Signature of the record owner or authorized agent cannot be verified; the required notarization and evidence of signatory authorization cannot be confirmed.

Ownership and Lien Search Certificate from a third-party title company is not found in the supplementary documents. A current title search certificate from a title company, dated within 30 days of submittal (05/20/2025), is required.
